Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time earlier — really helpful to understand NovaGrid's ingestion volume and the two key goals you called out (reducing per-query cost and making inference predictable for batch jobs). Per our call I captured three short priorities:

- Peak-hour tail-latency under 120ms for interactive queries
- 40% inferred unit cost reduction on historical workloads
- Ability to pin models for audit/regulatory tests

Next recommended step: a 30-minute product intro (high-level demo + deployment options) that includes your infra/contact owners so we can align on integration and success criteria. Can you confirm who from NovaGrid should attend (engineering, infra, security)? If helpful, Logan would run the demo and Mina will join for the integration/ops questions.

I pulled together the raw discovery notes and a proposed attendee matrix (attached). If you’re ready, I can propose three concrete windows — two weekday late-morning options and one late-afternoon slot — to make it easy for stakeholders across time zones.

A couple quick asks before we lock the slot:
- Which SSO provider do you use for role-based access (Okta/OneLogin/Azure AD)?
- Any compliance guardrails we should call out ahead of time (data residency, audit logs)?

Appreciate the quick confirmation and any attendee names you can share.

Thanks,
